meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
Choosing the right face wash for oily skin depends on whether you also struggle with acne, blackheads, or sensitive skin. For a budget under ₹500, the Indian market offers exceptional science-backed and gentle formulations.

The top recommendations for oily skin under ₹500 include:

### 1. Best Overall for Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=Simple%20Kind%20to%20Skin%20Refreshing%20Facewash%20Mild,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B929.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹299[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=Simple%20Kind%20to%20Skin%20Refreshing%20Facewash%20Mild,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B929.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=Simple%20Kind%20to%20Skin%20Refreshing%20Facewash%20Mild,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B929.)
  * **Why buy it:** This is a gold standard for persistent oiliness and blackheads. Salicylic acid is oil-soluble, meaning it deeply penetrates pores to clear out trapped sebum and dead skin cells.[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Why%20it's%20loved%3A%20Salicylic%20acid%20deep%20cleans,Not%20always.%20Face%20washes%20are%20usually%20foam-based.) It is fragrance-free, sulfate-free, and contains zinc to help regulate sebum production.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=Their%202%25%20salicylic%20acid%20face%20wash%20is,People%20with%20dry%20patches%20or%20sensitive%20skin.)

### 2. Best for Deep Pores & Gentle Exfoliation

* **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹345 (Often on sale around ₹300)[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Why%20it's%20loved%3A%20Soothing%20formula%20with%20green,Face%20Shop%20Rice%20Water%20Bright%20Foaming%20Cleanser.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** Green Tea Extracts, Glycolic Acid[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.)
  * **Why buy it:** A cult-favorite for combination-to-oily skin.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.) It features glycolic acid (an AHA) which gently sloughs off dead skin, while green tea helps soothe inflammation and control excess grease.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.) It leaves skin feeling refreshed without a tight, squeaky-dry feeling.

### 3. Best Dermatologist-Recommended Clinical Option

* **Saslic DS Foaming Face Wash[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Best%20for%3A%20All%20skin%20types.%20Rating%3A%208.5%2F10.,best%20face%20cleanser%20for%20face%20in%20India%3F)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹450[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Best%20for%3A%20All%20skin%20types.%20Rating%3A%208.5%2F10.,best%20face%20cleanser%20for%20face%20in%20India%3F)
  * **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Why%20it's%20loved%3A%20Soothing%20formula%20with%20green,Face%20Shop%20Rice%20Water%20Bright%20Foaming%20Cleanser.)
  * **Why buy it:** Frequently prescribed by dermatologists for stubborn oil control and acne.[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Best%20for%3A%20All%20skin%20types.%20Rating%3A%208.5%2F10.,best%20face%20cleanser%20for%20face%20in%20India%3F) It creates a rich foam that effectively cuts through heavy sebum. *Note: Because it is potent, start by using it once a day or every alternate day if you are new to high-strength acids.*

### 4. Best Budget Multi-Tasker (Oil + Brightening)

* **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Oil Control Face Wash[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.)**
  *   * **Price:** ~₹299[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.)
  * **Key Ingredients:** Salicylic Acid and Niacinamide[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.)
  * **Why buy it:** This combines salicylic acid (to clear pores) with niacinamide (to control sebum and fade post-acne dark spots).[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.) It’s a great balanced formula if your oily skin is also prone to blemishes and uneven texture.

---

### Quick Selection Guide:

* **If you have active pimples/acne:** Go with **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid** or **Saslic DS**.
* **If you want a refreshing, antioxidant daily wash:** Go with **Plum Green Tea**.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=Salicylic%20acid%20at%202%25%20can%20be%20drying,279%20Available%20At%3A%20Plum%20website%2C%20Nykaa%2C%20Amazon.)
* **If you want to control oil while tackling dark spots:** Go with **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide**.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.)
